caption: The drawing contains seven distinct colored fabric swatches depicted as geometric shapes against a plain, off-white background. The top row features three upward-pointing triangles: the left triangle is olive green with black branches and purple or dark violet leaf clusters, the middle triangle is a pale yellow with repetitive brown abstract motifs, and the right triangle is a pale peach color with diagonal hatching and pink-red floral prints. The middle row displays three more triangles: the left triangle is gray with blue squares connected by thin blue lines, the middle triangle is off-white with a blue floral design, and the right triangle is brown with beige and gray wavy stripes and abstract circle details. The bottom row features a single rectangle, which is the largest shape, adorned with an ornate pattern consisting of red, turquoise, gray, and white floral and geometric motifs on a black background. The composition is balanced, with the triangles evenly spaced above the rectangle.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
